# teams config set

Set a configuration value

## Usage

```
teams config set <key> [value] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `key` | Config key to set | Yes |
| `value` | Value to set. Omit to pick interactively. | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->

## Optional usage telemetry

`teams config set telemetry on` records explicit opt-in; `off` disables collection
and clears installation/project correlation state and unsent records. The default
is off. `--json` is supported. Re-enrollment starts a new identity and first-use period.
Production collection remains disabled pending release approval.

When enabled, observations cover first CLI use, project creation, login,
registration, endpoint/socket configuration, install-link opening, and npm
postinstall hooks for previously enrolled installations. A fresh install sends
nothing. Opening a link is not confirmation of Teams installation; the CLI does
not collect messages or confirmed runtime milestones. Project paths stay local;
exported facts and app/bot/tenant GUIDs are allowlisted.
`DO_NOT_TRACK=1` and `TEAMS_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1` override enrollment.

Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement
